_doc: Retraction sweep: every PMID in every role across all live topics, checked against PubMed efetch and Crossref. Raw responses are held outside the tree; each fetch here carries url, status, sha256, fetched_utc. A fetch failure is NOT_CHECKED (never NONE_FOUND). Generated by scripts/retraction_sweep.py --sweep; gated by --check (verify_all limb).

kinds.description: a pooled row served on a live page: review.json outcomes[*].trials id / family_report_id, strands members, integrity.membership_pooled
the own report of a COUNTABLE G1 tracker row (g1_countable or in_our_pool): family, seeded_funnel / screen_eligibility / identity / confirm_binding pmid, pool_join pool_row
review.json screening.records[*] with id_type pmid (included AND excluded)
the topic's comparator meta-analysis: review.json comparator.pmid, comparator_panel id / replaces
trials the comparator panel lists: comparator_panel[*].trial_set[*].aliases id
a held comparator record directory: cache/comparators/<pmid>/ (shared across topics)
any other PMID in a G1 tracker row or topic block (non-countable rows, candidates, named differences): outputs/k_gap/g1/<slug>.json, outputs/k_gap/G1_TRACKER.json
a meta-analysis PMID cited by the tracker (comparator_pmid, meta_pmid, source_meta, ...)
a held full text: cache/<slug>/ft_<pmid>.txt, fulltext_ledger rows HELD/FETCHED, cache/<slug>/comparator_fulltext.txt
